**sdd/issue-809-promote-migration/design**

Full files: openspec/changes/issue-809-promote-migration/{specs/promote-migration/spec.md, design.md, tasks.md} (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-809).

Spec: 5 requirements — JSON-only fenced brain-migration/1 contract (JS/migrate() refused); number computed+shown+signed per #806 (next-minor above max(package, tail), --as override, ≤ tail refuses monotonic-forever); the splice proves itself (temp import + migrateConfig clean BEFORE staging); same ceremony/stops as ADRs (typed confirmation, human commit = signature, Tier 3 assisted never bypassed); the three pending drafts converted and parsed.

Design: T1 lib/migration-draft.mjs mirrors amendment-draft.mjs (parseMigrationDraft, proposeVersion, spliceMigrationEntry — pure, refusals as sentences); T2 dispatch by basename BEFORE the ADR/amendment split, proof runs BEFORE the plan is shown (a plan the proof failed is never offered for signing); T3 conversions keep draft numbers (D2 renumbers at promote time — the point). No new surface (C4), no cascade (KNOWN_PATHS derives automatically), promote-guards run unchanged.

Tasks: single PR ~180 countable, closes #809, no chain, strict TDD, 6 items.
